purpose: 跨 benchmark 的组件更新与策略训练登记；本文件本身不启动 runner。共享策略与 Strategy Memory 已由累计六题统一更新；prepare_policy_trial.py 读取当前候选并写入新的冻结 manifest，qc_run 按该 manifest 执行。

label_boundary.training_labels: 官方 grader 的训练集标签仅供外层训练器监督策略更新。
label_boundary.validation_labels: 验证集标签仅用于外层评估与版本选择，不作为内层构建输入或经验条目。
label_boundary.test_labels: 测试集标签仅用于最终留出评估，不用于策略更新、经验入库或版本选择。
label_boundary.online_inputs: 线上组件使用公开 Task、实际用户补充、允许访问的证据和已发布经验；不读取当前题或测试集的隐藏 grader。
label_boundary.split_unit: 按任务族或模板划分；同题作品、多轮轨迹及翻译变体保持在同一分区。

next_policy_candidate.scope: Shared development update across ten exposed tasks; six-case live acceptance

training.update_semantics: Jointly review accumulated training pairs. Rewrite or remove wrong guidance, merge repetition, update/revoke individual Strategy Memory units and bind the new snapshot to one shared policy. Historical versions remain immutable; no automatic prompt append.

joint_update_contract.review_input: All cumulative training Reward Pack / official Grader pairs plus construction trajectories, including failed and zero-Reward attempts. Absence of accuracy evidence is unknown; stability/efficiency can still inform updates.
joint_update_contract.versioning: Bind the selected memory snapshot hash into one shared policy; jointly validate. Unchanged units are allowed after review.
joint_update_contract.current_optimizer: Codex direct outer review; legacy paid PolicyOptimizer remains prompt/parameter-only and is not the joint-update path.
joint_update_contract.label_boundary: No held-out labels, hidden rubric text or per-task answer keys in inner memory.

previous_policy_trial.scope: One shared Engine policy plus Strategy Memory updated jointly from all six tasks, 42 version records / 40 unique Packs; no per-task policy patches.

accuracy.name: 更准
evidence: valid quality distinctions with grounded observations
accuracy.boundary: Do not infer official scores from pass counts or inject hidden answers into inner guidance.

robustness.name: 更稳
evidence: honest unknowns and bounded unproductive actions

efficiency.name: 更快
evidence: active wall seconds excluding audited user pauses
physical model requests and role/token usage
avoided redundant construction, reading and remeasurement
efficiency.boundary: Do not gain speed by dropping required checks, weakening standards or relabeling unknown as pass.

trial_preparation.selection: Read next_policy_candidate and bind its policy, Strategy Memory and source hashes into every new manifest; no hardcoded candidate version.
trial_preparation.scope: Reuse parent trial public inputs, archives, models and budgets; historical manifests remain immutable.
trial_preparation.execution: Local preparation only; does not start workers or call models.

release_acceptance.applies_to: Every shared policy, Strategy Memory or flow update; validate their exact combined source binding.
required: Known real failure trajectories replay without unbounded retries or loss of valid results.
Bounded live construction on representative tasks demonstrates autonomous delivery or justified bounded termination.
Report delivery failures, execution unknowns, operator intervention, requests and elapsed time separately from Reward accuracy.
release_acceptance.promotion_rule: Local tests alone do not establish stable operation. Operator intervention to stop an execution loop fails stability acceptance; successful bounded termination alone does not establish productive delivery.
release_acceptance.quality_boundary: This is Engine execution acceptance, not an additional semantic veto on publishing the best usable Reward.
release_acceptance.current_candidate_stability: not_passed: execution08 live validation pending; older execution06 T110 and PPT delivered autonomously, execution07 inventory running.

qc.current_state: 真实 SDK 控制工具、磁盘会话、版本账本与固定预算已接生产构建。Claw 用户多轮及 Office 单步 Actor 工具实跑成功，完整 QC 尚有未发布和不确定结果。

runtime_monitor.boundary: 未来 runner 使用新冻结 manifest；本登记不修改旧预算。监控检测执行循环，不证明 Reward 的语义质量。

implementation_changes: 通过工具调用 Jury、Builder、Quality Review、Hypothesis、Search、经验检索及沙箱 Actor。
控制 Reward 构建、局部修复与复测循环，保存候选版本和证据。
在硬预算内分配调用额度，决定继续、停止及是否发布；质量不足时保留问题与候选版本。

agentic_search.current_state: 已提供 QC 定向调查接口，问题与策略进入缓存身份；禁网保护、多次证据挂接和旧 Search 回归通过。
implementation_changes: 复用现有研究循环，提供 QC 按具体疑点调用的定向调查接口。
复用已读证据，围绕关键冲突追查来源，返回适用条件和未解决问题。
将查询、选材、阅读、停止与汇总提示词纳入策略版本，并接入 QC 共享预算。

jury.current_state: 已接入 QC 标准生成工具；运行时策略版本接线待完成。
implementation_changes: 以公开 Task 和实际用户补充为依据，提炼硬性要求、质量维度及相对重要性；知识和经验选择性参考。
根据 QC 提供的已核验反例校准标准，记录修订依据及适用范围。

reward_builder.current_state: 已接入 QC 构建与局部修复工具；完整 SDK 链验证尚未通过。
implementation_changes: 根据标准和可用证据选择检查方法，构建可执行检查器及其输入输出契约。
接收定位后的缺陷与目标标准，生成局部修复候选并交由 QC 安排复测。

quality_review.current_state: 已接入 QC 定向攻击、历史争议保留与修复复测工具；真实模型质量仍待实跑验证。
implementation_changes: 保留多模型攻击与独立参考机制，生成有针对性的反例并运行候选检查器。
区分标准错误、检查器实现错误和证据不足，返回定位信息与不确定性。
复测修订版本，检查原误判是否消失以及是否引入新的误判。

hypothesis.current_state: 已增加内部 Reward 缺陷假设工具，输出预测及验证方案；不向 Actor 注入执行建议。
implementation_changes: 根据 Task、候选 Reward、质检缺口与相关经验提出改进 Reward 的假设。
输出可验证预测与验证方案，由 QC 决定是否补查、修订或调用 Actor。
假设用于内部构建循环，不直接作为 Actor 的任务执行建议。

experience_memory.current_state: QC先检索摘要再显式选择完整策略，0..8条/16KiB仅为当前工作集上限。10条heuristic保留；本地验证通过，尚无新付费实跑。
implementation_changes: 短常驻策略；长期经验独立成 MATCH/SUMMARY/STRATEGY/AVOID/VALIDATION 单元。
retrieve_strategy返回候选摘要；load_strategy由QC选择、替换或清空当前工作集。最多8条/16384字节，0条合法，不固定top-k加载。
后续模块仅使用QC选中且适用的策略，记录选择来源和任务作用域；恢复会话可复用，作用域变化后失效。
每轮外层训练同时审阅共享策略和Strategy Memory，新增、改写、合并或撤销单元，两者共同绑定版本和验证。
本地检索不调用模型；Agent选择仍消耗正常token，不将旧回执历史误称为16KiB以内。

outer_trainer.responsibility: 使用训练集官方标签提出策略更新，在验证集选择版本；记录策略、经验库、数据分区与评估结果的版本对应关系。
outer_trainer.current_state: 当前由Codex直接共同审阅全部训练Reward/官方Grader配对和失败轨迹，更新共享策略、Strategy Memory及flow代码；两轮六题实跑已完成。旧qc_train/PolicyExperiment付费优化器与三家readout仅为旧接口，不是当前联合更新入口。验证选版和留出实跑尚未完成。

actor_runtime.responsibility: 复用已有 Runtime，在对应沙箱及 QC 分配的预算内生成真实作品、环境变化和公开轨迹，供 Reward 验证；Actor 策略固定。

benchmark_adapters.responsibility: 复用两套 benchmark 接线并适配 QC；支持单轮及多轮的实际需求、作品和环境证据，将外层官方评分与内层构建输入隔离。

runtime_artifacts.outer_training_library_boundary: Legacy paid single-generation interface; do not use as the current Codex direct joint-update runner.
